name: crate-digger
description: Crate Digger — a premium, non-clone music discovery application built on the Spotify Web API.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
